mapper.sql: r.*, o.order_no, p.title AS product_title, p.skus AS product_skus, s.name AS shop_name, u.nickname AS reviewer_nickname, u.avatar AS reviewer_avatar
FROM product_reviews r LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id LEFT JOIN shops s ON s.shop_id = r.shop_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_reviews (order_id, order_item_id, product_id, shop_id, user_id, score, content, images, anonymous, sku, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{shopId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{images}, #{anonymous}, #{sku}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE products p SET p.rating = (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.score), 2) FROM product_reviews r WHERE r.product_id = p.id), p.review_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews r WHERE r.product_id = p.id), p.updated_at = now() WHERE p.id = #{productId}

UPDATE shops s SET s.score = (SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.rating), 2) FROM products p WHERE p.shop_id = s.shop_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.rating IS NOT NULL), s.updated_at = now() WHERE s.shop_id = #{shopId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p2 WHERE p2.shop_id = #{shopId} AND p2.deleted = 0 AND p2.rating IS NOT NULL)

SELECT r.product_id AS productId, p.title AS productTitle, p.skus AS productSkus, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reply_content IS NOT NULL AND r.reply_content <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replied, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reply_content IS NULL OR r.reply_content = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreplied, SUM(CASE WHEN r.append_content IS NOT NULL AND r.append_content <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withAppend FROM product_reviews r LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} GROUP BY r.product_id, p.title, p.skus ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS rating,COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*)) AS goodRate FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT score, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY score
SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS cnt,ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS rating FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY sku ORDER BY cnt DESC, sku
SELECT score FROM shops WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_reviews SET reply_content = #{content}, reply_time = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND reply_content IS NULL
UPDATE product_reviews SET append_content = #{content}, append_time = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND append_content IS NULL
